senses.gloss: f. (v. זָרָב) a tray or saucer fastened to the bottom of a drinking vessel for the reception of drippings; in gen. saucer, dish, disk.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 35:1">Pesik. R. s. 35</cite> <he>שנדמה כז׳ קטנה וכ׳</he> (ed. Fr. <he>זרבוכ׳</he>, corr. acc.) whose face appeared (over the camp) like a small disk of fire; Yalk. Dan. 1062 <he>כביבית</he> (corr. acc., or <he>כגִיגִית</he>).—Pl. <cite ref="G00665"><he>זַרְבּוּבִיּוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:3">Lev. R. s. 5</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:1">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (expl. <he>מזרקי</he>, <cite ref="Amos 6:6">Am. VI, 6</cite>) <he>כוסות שיש להם ז׳</he> cups with saucers; Yalk. Am. 545 <he>שאין בהם זכוכית</he> (corr. acc.).
